independence: All judgments were recorded from the saved atlas and independently rendered fixed central enlargements before reading any primary review or adopted labels. Selected sample and prior scientific context were known; this is not blinded scientific validation or human review.
method: Actual inspection of every record on all 24 frozen atlas pages, including original raw counts, positive excess and native spectra in every available covering order. Additionally inspected all 51 panels on nine central enlargement pages. The enlargement uses all 31 rows and fixed central columns 8:25 of each unchanged 31x33 cutout; all scales and cutout hashes are logged in secondary_enlarged/INDEX.json. No sample, mapping, classifier threshold or extraction was changed. Labels below are manually recorded descriptive judgments.

codebook.O: Provisional OI wavelength plus photon-compatible morphology; not proven sky origin
codebook.U: Unresolved broad, ambiguous or potentially blended structure
codebook.M: At least one covering order lacks required verified mapping/full cutout
codebook.N: Native/raw product pair unavailable; no morphology assessment

limits: A and O are provisional morphology compatibility judgments, not physical-origin proofs.
Broad two-order features remain unresolved even if one raw panel also contains a separate off-trace charge-like deposit.
No qualified laser candidate, calibrated null result, global false-alarm rate or sensitivity follows from this descriptive post-detection review.
The two AI-agent reviews are not independent human validation or blinded scientific validation.
Bright outer calibration-fiber pixels affect whole-cutout display contrast; fixed central enlargements are display aids only.
